ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To choose your profile photo and, if you are a coach, the photos in your meal books.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: To count the steps you take each day and add them to your nutrition plan, so you don't have to log them by hand.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: To read the steps you take each day, including those from your Apple Watch, and add them to your nutrition plan so you don't have to log them by hand.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: UDECA only reads your steps from Health for your nutrition plan. It never writes or changes any Health data.
